$Comment: The toast and the crack a player gets when a broken block turns up a Cursed Geode during
Hallow's Eve. The file name is the moment id, and it is the Cue the two geode rows
(BonusRows/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Geode_Find*.json) put on their find roll; a cue plays only
when the roll beside it handed something over, so this never fires on an empty block.
The geode lands where the block broke, which is why the words point at the rubble. Key is a line
in this pack's hallowseve.world.lang, written bare; Sound is any SoundEvent id, played where the
player stands. Delete either group to drop that half.
